_comment: Triage verdicts for scripts/docs_loss_audit.py, one entry per audit (keyed by the base commit's
first 7 hex). Item keys are sha1[:12] of (unit + normalised unit text) as the script prints them;
`text` is a human excerpt the script never reads back. `thresholds` pin the script's constants:
a mismatch voids the triage (exit 2). intentional/superseded need `record` (path#anchor on the
head tree) + `quote` (>= 4 words found in that record); restored needs `commit`; noise needs
`note` (items) or `pattern` (rules). A rule needs unit + source + max_matches + verdict, and a
`category` from the removal catalogue of the record when it absorbs partial/gone sentences.
`untriaged_max` is a ratchet: it only goes down.
